title: The Night Soldiers Rose Inside a Tamil Fort, 51 Years Before 1857 | Vellore 1806 #shorts

lines.text: Fifty one years before the great revolt of eighteen fifty seven, Indian soldiers rose against the British inside a Tamil fort.
lines.caps: *51 years | before | the revolt | of *1857 | Indian *soldiers | *rose | inside | a *Tamil fort.

lines.text: The fort was Vellore. The night was the tenth of July, eighteen oh six.
lines.caps: the fort | was *Vellore | the *night | was *10 July | *1806.

lines.text: It began with a uniform. In eighteen oh five, new orders for the Company's sepoys banned marks on the forehead, and told them to shave their beards.
lines.caps: it began | with a *uniform | in *1805 | new *orders | for the *sepoys | *no marks | on the *forehead | *shave | the *beards.

lines.text: Then came a new round hat. Rumour said its badge was made of leather from animals the soldiers would never touch.
lines.caps: then | a new *round hat | *rumour said | its *badge | was *leather | from animals | they would | *never touch.

lines.text: Men who refused were punished. Accounts say two of them were flogged and thrown out of the army.
lines.caps: men who *refused | were *punished | accounts say | two were | *flogged | and thrown *out.

lines.text: Inside the same fort lived the family of Tipu Sultan, held there since his death in seventeen ninety nine.
lines.caps: inside | the same fort | the *family | of *Tipu Sultan | *held there | since *1799.

lines.text: The day before, one of his daughters was married, and many guests came into the fort.
lines.caps: the day | *before | one of his | *daughters | was *married | many *guests | came in.

lines.text: A little after two in the morning, the sepoys struck. Many British soldiers of the sixty ninth regiment were killed as they slept.
lines.caps: after *2 AM | the sepoys | *struck | British soldiers | of the *69th | *killed | as they *slept.

lines.text: Accounts count fourteen officers and about a hundred and fifteen men dead. The flag of Mysore was raised over the fort.
lines.caps: *14 officers | about *115 | men *dead | the flag | of *Mysore | was *raised.

lines.text: But word got out, and reached the British cavalry at Arcot, about twenty five kilometres away.
lines.caps: but *word | got *out | it reached | *Arcot | about *25 km | *away.

lines.text: Colonel Rollo Gillespie rode ahead with a few horsemen. Then the guns came, and blasted open the gate.
lines.caps: Colonel | *Rollo Gillespie | rode *ahead | then | the *guns came | *blasted | open the *gate.

lines.text: Within hours, the rising was crushed. Around three hundred and fifty sepoys were killed. About a hundred are said to have been shot without trial.
lines.caps: within *hours | it was *crushed | around *350 | sepoys *killed | about *100 | said to be | shot without *trial.

lines.text: After trials, some were tied to cannon and blown away. Others were shot or hanged. And the new dress orders were withdrawn.
lines.caps: after *trials | some | *blown from cannon | others | *shot | or *hanged | the dress orders | *withdrawn.

lines.text: The Governor of Madras and the army chief were recalled. Tipu's family was sent to Calcutta. Whether they planned the rising is still not clear.

lines.text: The fort still stands. Its night of rebellion, half a century early, is mostly forgotten. Follow Aazhi for more.
